verdict.rationale: Obsidian's docs say notes are non-proprietary plain-text Markdown files stored locally, usable offline, and the app is free with no sign-up, so it runs without the vendor's cloud. Community users corroborate this: notes live only on their own machine and they own their files. Missing for 10: a first-party self-hosted sync backend; syncing across devices without Obsidian Sync relies on third-party services like Git or Dropbox rather than a server the user operates through Obsidian itself.
